    warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id

    product_information p ON i.product_id = p.product_id

    order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

WHERE
    p.product_status = 'orderable'
    AND i.quantity_on_hand >= 50
GROUP BY
    w.warehouse_id,
    p.product_id,
    p.product_name
